name: Learn deposits, not just individual blocks

pages.text: GregTech resources are often found in substantial deposits. Finding the right deposit and remembering where it is can be more valuable than collecting a few scattered blocks.
Use the scanner guidance in the quest book and keep your equipment charged when required. Record useful locations with clear names: the material, the dimension and whether you have begun mining it.
Bring enough torches, food, blocks and repair supplies to investigate a discovery properly. Mark the route out before digging a complicated underground network.
